# Known, deliberate differences between Arrmada's replies and Audiobookshelf's
# (TestRepliesMatchAudiobookshelf). One per line: <step|*> <json.path> <kind> <reason>
# kind is missing, null, kind, idshape, body or status, as the test reports it, so
# allowing an id's shape never hides that id going missing. "*" matches the path in
# every step; "[]" is any array element; a path ending in "*" covers everything under
# it. A line that no longer matches a difference fails TestAllowedDiffsAreNotStale:
# remove it when the gap is closed. Everything here is deliberate.
